stage: V36: single-message compression, message-age strata and joint-event diagnosis
frozen_before: V36 prediction scores and paired control replays
physical_model: ../reconstruction_v34/model_fit.json; unchanged V5 physical trip chains, prior, support and cancellation model

candidate.name: single_message
candidate.eligible_forecast: Latest numeric records already received. For each physical trip, retain only slots strictly after its greatest hard-observed slot; without an own observation all numeric slots are eligible. This uses known passage order, never a scheduled/predicted-time cutoff that would delete a late vehicle.
candidate.selector: Select maximum receipt timestamp; break ties by earliest original physical chain slot. Neither prediction value, future actual label, objective value nor realized gain enters this selector.
candidate.likelihood: Apply the selected endpoint's V35 fitted Gaussian emission only. Raw forecasts and all notices remain public. Hard observations and local nonoccurrence are unchanged. After a receipt, withdrawal or new hard observation, recompute the same rule.
candidate.interpretation: A cheap executable compression baseline, not complete-history Bayesian filtering. It both selects one signal and omits numeric messages on a known completed prefix; score differences alone do not identify forecast-error correlation as the cause.
candidate.variants: Exactly this selector. No tuned age cutoff, alternative tie rule, tempering, correlation parameter or posterior fit.

validation.queries: Reuse all saved V35 endpoint (9070) and onboard (3010) queries, including unsupported records if any. No outcome-based rescreening.
validation.reuse: Reuse old three-model marginal predictions exactly. Rebuild only the previously uncomputed joint posterior scores for old models; score the new model once. No old policy rollout bank is repeated.
validation.joint_scope: At the known first-leg arrival, exact two-slot posterior of the next same-trip connection departure and arrival, conditional on both operating, with only the original available messages and first-leg hard observations.

joint_events.J1: departure <= scheduled departure + 300 AND arrival <= scheduled arrival + 300

validation.joint_metrics: Probability and Brier for J1 and J2; also probability under the product of the same two-slot conditional marginals, to expose what physical dependence changes. This is two-event validation, not validation of the entire joint distribution.

strata.age_rule: Use common raw target-message age: <=600, (600,1800], >1800; no target message separately.
strata.count_rule: Use common raw history and latest observed slot: 0, 1, 2-4, 5+. Also retain original raw active forecast count. Never use the selected model's count of one to stratify.

validation.aggregation: Equal-date means on common supported queries, with all counts, per-date positive/negative comparisons and target-message subset retained. No endpoint-iid significance claims.
validation.decision: This is a structural diagnostic, not a new scalar acceptance gate. Report prediction, joint-event and physical-control tradeoffs separately. Preserve the failed V35 gate; do not adjust any model after seeing these scores.

paired_replay.cohort: All unchanged 72 V34 roots, menus, MCT, deadlines, actual endpoints and public message streams
paired_replay.sampling: Unchanged disagreement-triggered standard rollout: 128 shared worlds per actual trigger, seed=34050+1000*root_index+call_index, no retries; same combined continuation, no future message archives, every unresolved draw retained.
paired_replay.comparison: Compare each controller against the same V35 all-message controller and the V34 own-only cheap controllers. Compare new rollout against both fixed new cheap controllers. No root-wise oracle baseline.
paired_replay.timing: All cold model/history setup, selection, scoring, sampling and continuations charged; IO/graph preparation separate. Logical-clock quality replay.

training_diagnosis: Read-only October 1-2 residual and age summaries. Paired raw residual correlation is descriptive and cannot by itself disprove conditional independence given the full latent trajectory. No parameter fitting or rule selection follows it.
stop: Finish the fixed diagnostic and 216 replays. Preserve all negative cases. No additional model variant, new large DP/search, or novel-algorithm admission based on this stage alone.
data_status: Previously developed dates; validation dates disjoint from six policy dates but not pristine scientific confirmation. Reuse local artifacts, no server transfer.
